text:
maya (AE): Prospect (Nimbus Labs) asked for a perf POC next week. Goal: steady 1k QPS, 30s microbursts to 3k, p95 <200ms. They want runbook, cost estimate (hosted + dedicated reserve), and security answers (KMS/HSM + audit logs).

sam (SE): Got it. Which model + average tokens?

maya (AE): Conversation assistant. prompt ~110 tokens, response ~140. Prefer redwood-7b int8 but open to cheaper fallbacks.

raj (infra): Draft load plan: 5m smoke, 10m ramp to 1k, 45m steady, 3x bursts (30s @3k) spaced ~12m. Warm KV cache needed. Concurrency target = QPS * p95 -> 1k * 0.2 = 200; add 2x headroom -> 400.

raj (infra): Quick wrk examples: 
wrk -t6 -c350 -d45m -R1000 --latency -s scripts/llm_post.lua
wrk -t6 -c1100 -d30s -R3000 --latency -s scripts/llm_post.lua

sam (SE): Baseline config: batch_size=24, kv_cache=true, quant=int8, pin redwood-7b-q8. Fallback chain: [redwood-3b-q4, redwood-1.3b-q4].

ana (sec): Security note: Hosted & Dedicated support customer-managed KMS (CMK). HSM only for Private. Audit-log export ok, will prepare redacted sample. Need retention policy from customer.

maya (AE): Pricing asks: hosted estimate including burst allowance; and 1-month reserved estimate for Dedicated. Can someone ballpark GPU count?

raj (infra): Ballpark Dedicated: 5-8 A100-equiv depending on batching and autoscale aggressiveness. I'll give a monthly reserved range. Hosted: give steady + burst hourly and call out token estimate.

sam (SE): I'll assemble runbook: steps, smoke checks, dashboards (p50/p95/p99), rollback on tail >300ms. Add GPU util monitor and auto-fallback script if gpu_util >80%.

ops-bot: job scheduled: nimbus_poc/1748201234/run1 @ 2024-11-20T18:00Z

maya (AE): Proposed window Tue 18:00 UTC, 2h. @sam @raj you own test ops. @ana please prepare sec Q responses by EOD tomorrow.

raj (infra): I'll push wrk script + llm_post.lua to shared drive and stub Grafana dashboard.

sam (SE): Will include CSV template for results and a short cost model: tokens/hr, steady vs bursts, reserved capacity delta.

ana (sec): On it. I'll include SOC2 summary and sample audit log. Legal will flag HSM requirement.

maya (AE): Thanks team. I'll confirm with Nimbus and share their questionnaire when received.
